title: On relative Ulrich bundles and generalized Clifford algebras
summary: We give a Clifford-theoretic description of relatively Ulrich bundles on smooth families of hypersurfaces. A split projection centre produces an explicit monic Clifford algebra whose locally free representations are exactly the relatively Ulrich bundles. For quadric fibrations, the description is intrinsic and requires no projection centre; the even Clifford algebra gives exact formulas for the minimal relative Ulrich rank in terms of Brauer classes and monodromy. We also obtain applications to stability, moduli, and relative wildness.
